description: A fixed filter bank: twelve band pass filters with their own levels, plus a low pass and a high pass at the ends

params.text: Sets the level of the band centred on the frequency printed above it
Sets the level of everything below 88Hz
Sets the level of everything above 7kHz
Takes the whole bank out of circuit and passes the input straight to the output

outputs.text: The fourteen bands summed at the levels their knobs are set to
